decisions.source: Owner instruction 2026-09-24: when identity, condition, SKU, or quantity is unclear, preserve the original cell in an on-hold description for exception staff rather than guessing a catalog pairing.
decisions.countSemantics: Sheet quantities are cycle counts: delta = sheet - current, reason CYCLE_COUNT.
decisions.unknownQty: Create the on-hold product but do not write a count; description says COUNT NEEDED.
decisions.conditions: New/used, colour, model, BAD/parts, in-box, OOS and wrong-image details remain in the raw description. Variants receive separate on-hold SKUs when their identity is not unambiguous.
